The review had one HIGH, and it is a false alarm, so I made no fix and shipped nothing.

**HIGH 346cf114ddbf, v28.84 deer carcass branch: FALSE ALARM.** The code around line 36284 of `dark_raiders.html` is one unbroken if / else-if / else chain: `if(CT.dead&&CT.crc){ /* empty */ } else if(CT.dead){…} else if(CT.k==='bird'){…} else { /* live deer */ }`. A dead deer with a carcass container takes the empty branch first, so it skips the dead block, the bird block and the live-deer block. The reviewer's worry was a fall-through into the live-deer drawing, and that can't happen. The container draws the carcass.

I left the MED findings alone because the task covers only HIGHs. The verdict is in `tools/handoff/console/notes/50-review-20261018.md`.
